## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 35. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke opens on the strangeness of the realignment itself — if Sacramento State being in the MAC wasn't enough of a mind-eff, Northern Illinois is a member of the retooled Mountain West. He sets out the sequence: Harley was the DC last season under Thomas Hammock and is the interim HC for this season after Hammock took a job with the Seahawks. He records the lineage — Harley is a Pat Narduzzi disciple and was also a GA under Narduzzi and Mark Dantonio for two years — then states the constraints plainly: the 43-year-old has never been a head coach, and finds himself in a weird situation to say the least with the travel, games at elevation, and the transfer portal opening up when Hammock left in February.
